bladestan-identical-always-true.reason: An engine defect, not the translation's: in a Blade view's compiled PHP, php/values.rerail's integer value (`php_value(n, "int", v)`: `kind(n, "integer"), value(n, v)`) has rows or none depending on the reading rule's other literals: with `op(e, "===")` beside it, none, so `@if (1 === 1)` (bladestan's skeleton/resources/views/foo.blade.php:3) is not found. Plain PHP files have the rows either way; the original and PHPStan (bladestan) report the line. Repro: `@if (1 === 1) x @endif` as `a.blade.php`, `rerail-engine run-policies` with bladestan-identical-always-true.rerail alone: no diagnostic (beside bladestan-if-always-true.rerail: none either) (docs/rule-syntax/packs/PORT-1120.md, Checks).

tlint-space-after-blade-directives.reason: Control directives Blade leaves unpaired (`Lead @forelse($arg) Trail`, `@for($args)`, a bare `@while`) are reported by tlint, which matches directives line by line, and by the translation, which reads the template's directives; the original reads compiled structures, and the compiled view compiles no half of one. tlint v9.7.0's SpaceAfterBladeDirectives reports all 10 (and on fixtures and samples-blade reports exactly the translation's keys).
